title: Identifies stale async response overwriting newer UI state

rubric.criterion: Pinpoints the out-of-order async race condition at panel.js:40-52
rubric.check: Section 2 explains how an in-flight fetch resolves after closePanel()

rubric.criterion: Recommends a monotonic generation counter or AbortController fix
rubric.check: Section 2 provides a minimal guard before DOM mutation

failing_example.output: The fetch call works properly in local testing.
